meta.title: Yerevan Project
meta.subtitle: An interactive research map of urban space, social movements, and political events
meta.author: Alireza Bahrani
meta.description:
This map presents an ongoing research project on Yerevan's urban space — beginning with the Northern Avenue development and extending outward to the social movements of the 2000s and 2010s, the 2018 revolution, the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, and the everyday social life of the city's public spaces.

Each point is an event fixed in time and place. Use the timeline to watch the city's political geography accumulate, and the themes to isolate one thread of the argument at a time.
meta.note: This is a working research instrument, not a finished publication. Entries marked EXAMPLE are placeholders demonstrating the data format and should be replaced.
